 Duncan Robinson drops 17 points Friday against Heat 
 by Chris Schommer | Pistons Correspondent | Sat, Oct 24th 2026, 10:14am EDT 
 Duncan Robinson dropped 17 points (5-12 FG, 5-10 3PT, 2-2 FT) while also dishing out two assists, grabbing one rebound, and recording two steals in the Pistons' 128-111 win over the Heat Friday night. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Robinson has been impactful from beyond the arc early on, dropping five three-pointers in each of the first two contests. The 32-year-old remains a streaky sharpshooter that relies heavily on converting from long range, averaging 19.0 points per game while shooting 52.6% from long range and notching a usage rate of 22.7% so far this season.
